scope: Device installation metadata and read-only copied settings; historical source review; CPU controller/UI/proximity probes. No device gameplay, simulator launch, product patch, portal/map edits, or rebuilt installed apps.

ipad.HUD_preference: No HUD preference file in copied directory.

limitations: Installed iPad tied to Nov12 installation URL and archived package digest; its executable was not freshly read/hashed or executed. Legacy CPU framing/UI mode was compared to74825d2 historical source.
Current-iPad fixture is1024x1366 with explicit insets0/20/0/24, not a measurement of the installed iPad screen.
Camera settled600 ticks with scene paused, player original50 inward from each portal. Walk samples use original terrain and9 targets per portal,600tick limit, enemy damage ignored only by CPU host.
CPU text uses preparedTextStub; GPU pixels/actual OS gestures were not tested here. HUD placement bounds are not an exact alpha-occlusion mask.
Scene center-input acceptance is not proof of movement or portal entry. UI can consume a point first.
No success in9 selected samples does not prove impossibility of every route/gesture. The exact portal reported by the user is not identified.

boundary_correction.initial_probe_error: gate.y + nextafter(30,0) rounded back to the excluded distance30 boundary for Stage04_02/0.
boundary_correction.corrected: nextafter(gate.y+30,gate.y), verify actual abs(delta)<30 before projecting.
